title: US ATTACK ON QESHM RESIDENCE KILLS THREE, INCLUDING TODDLER, AND WOUNDS TWO SIBLINGS**
text:
US ATTACK ON QESHM RESIDENCE KILLS THREE, INCLUDING TODDLER, AND WOUNDS TWO SIBLINGS**"

"**QESHM, Iran** – A brutal American attack on a residential home in the Chah-Tango neighborhood of Qeshm city has resulted in the martyrdom of three family members, including a two-year-old child, while leaving two other children hospitalized with injuries."

"According to local reports, the US enemy forces struck the family's house, killing the father, the mother, and their 2-year-old child on the spot. Two other siblings, aged 7 and 9, sustained severe wounds in the assault and were immediately transported to a nearby hospital for urgent medical treatment."

"The strike on the densely populated residential area has sparked widespread outrage, highlighting the heavy civilian toll as the assault directly targeted a non-military family home. Medical officials have confirmed that the two young survivors are currently under close observation as they receive care for their injuries.
